A1.falsifier: The in-budget count is not above the measured A0 count. Collapse to the greedy call puts the count at 23, which is the low end of the range and fails the direction.
A1.high_meaning: Pass@k ceiling, any sample correct: sum over trajectories of 1-(1-23/200)^k with k in {4: 92, 2: 40, 1: 30, 0: 38}.
